name: yaps-text-to-speech
description: Turn text into a WAV audio file with Yaps.

interface.shortDescription: Turn text into a WAV audio file.
interface.longDescription: Convert text or a text file into speech using the local standard or expressive voice engines supplied by Yaps desktop. The plugin checks app, sign-in, model, mode, and voice readiness; protects existing outputs; and returns the exact WAV or PCM file generated by Yaps.
defaultPrompt: Turn this text into a WAV file with Yaps.
Create narration from this text file.
Set up local text-to-speech with Yaps.
